schema_version.description: Optional; default '1' when absent. Unknown versions rejected in v0.1 (Amendment v0.1.2 #1).

suite.description: Must match the parent directory name; directory must be in the v0.1 suite registry.

purpose.description: Mandatory and meaningful: what behaviour is tested and why it matters.

evidence.description: May be empty for suites where no documents are provided (e.g. fabricated_citations); the loader has no minimum. Ground truth: evalkit/cases.py — rejects a missing 'id'/'text' and unknown keys inside items; the evidence array itself may be empty.

id.description: Uppercase evidence ID; matches the citation-token regex so format mismatches are detectable. Unique within the case.

instruction.description: Sent to the model VERBATIM as the user turn; must be self-contained (references evidence by ID, includes format rules).

constraints.description: Human-readable summary of a compliant response; never machine-enforced.

type.description: Registered scorer name; unknown types rejected by the loader. See docs/scoring.md.

params.description: The ONLY enforcement source. Scorers never read 'expected' or 'constraints'.

weight.description: Float, optional, default 1.0 (Amendment v0.1.3 #6). Reported aggregates only; never pass/fail.

expected.description: DOCUMENTATION-ONLY sketch of a good response for human review (Amendment v0.1.2 #5).
